description_en: Query the historical diagnosis information of 5G cloud instances (excluding diagnosis results)
description_zh: 查询5G上云实例的历史诊断信息（不包含诊断结果）
name: ListDiagnoseInfoForSingleCard

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the 5G cloud instance
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en:
The source type for network diagnosis. Valid values:

Ip: Indicates that network diagnosis is performed by using the IP address of the Internet of Things card.

Iccid: Indicates that network diagnosis is performed by using the ID of the Internet of Things card
parameters.help_zh:
网络诊断的源类型。取值：

Ip：表示通过物联网卡的卡IP进行网络诊断。

Iccid：表示通过物联网卡的卡ID进行网络诊断
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source network interface card for network diagnosis
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The status of the network diagnostic task. Valid values:

success: indicates that the diagnosis succeeded.

failed: indicates that the diagnosis failed.

diagnosing: indicates that the diagnosis is in progress
parameters.help_zh:
网络诊断任务的状态。取值：
success：表示诊断成功。
failed：表示诊断失败。
diagnosing：表示诊断中
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no further query is available.

If NextToken has a return value, this value represents the token to start the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to display per page when querying results in batches. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default Value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

BeginTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the network diagnosis started. Unit: seconds
BeginTime.description_zh: 网络诊断的开始时间戳。单位：秒

CardIp.description_en: The IP address of the source card used for the network diagnosis
CardIp.description_zh: 网络诊断的源端卡的IP地址

Destination.description_en: The destination IP address or domain name for the network diagnosis
Destination.description_zh: 网络诊断的目的IP或者域名

DestinationType.description_en:
The destination type of the network diagnosis. Valid values:

IP: indicates that the destination type is an IP address.

Domain: indicates that the destination type is a domain name
DestinationType.description_zh:
网路诊断的目的类型。取值：

IP：表示诊断的目的类型是IP类型。

Domain：表示诊断的目的类型是域名类型

DiagnoseTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the diagnostic task was stored in the database. Unit: milliseconds
DiagnoseTime.description_zh: 诊断任务入库的时间戳。单位：毫秒

EndTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the network diagnosis ended. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 网络诊断的结束时间戳。单位：秒

IccId.description_en: The ID of the source card used for the network diagnosis

Source.description_en: The source NIC IP address or NIC ID for the network diagnosis
Source.description_zh: 网络诊断的源端卡IP或者卡ID

SourceType.description_en: The source type of the network diagnosis

Status.description_en:
The status of the network diagnostic task. Valid values:

success: The diagnosis succeeded.
failed: The diagnosis failed.
diagnosing: The diagnosis is in progress
Status.description_zh:
网络诊断任务的状态。取值：

success：表示诊断成功。
failed：表示诊断失败。
diagnosing：表示诊断中

WirelessCloudConnectorId.description_en: The ID of the 5G high-speed cloud instance

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page when results are queried in batches. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：20

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no further query is available.

If NextToken has a return value, this value represents the token to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
